race.comment: YOU SAID WHAT (11) is racing well and a win looks close. She's off a 30 day freshen up but ran well behind one with decent maiden form last time at Echuca having also just missed at Wodonga prior. Drawn a touch wide but should take plenty of holding out.  KOKONDA (2) resumes for his second campaign. He just found one better on debut at Kyneton and was sound thereafter. Drawn wide but has speed and has jumped out well on his home deck here, go close. THE CELLIST (13) might be better second time around and kicks off over 1400m. Betting will be key, though it wouldn't surprise to see him feature. SKILLED SAILOR (3) is better than he showed last time out and can be in the finish.
